scoring._comment: Scoring rules. Every sub-metric is stored with every result; the overall score is a documented weighted sum, never a replacement for the underlying metrics.

acceptance.rule: A result is ACCEPTED when it executes, produces valid solids, passes every critical engineering check, and its overall quality is >= threshold. A high geometric similarity can never compensate for a failed critical check.

geometry_scales._comment: Linear scores: 1 at perfect match, 0 at the stated error. Mean symmetric surface distance of 1 % of the reference bounding-box diagonal scores 0.

parametric_rules._comment: A probe re-runs the candidate's build() with one PARAMS value changed and compares the result with the reference built with the same change. It tests whether the parameters really drive the geometry with the specified design intent.

iteration_policy.feedback: Reference-free only: execution errors, failed specification checks and failed design-intent probes, phrased from the task specification. Reference geometry, IoU and surface distances are never shown to the model.

tasks.title: Mounting plate
tasks.prompt:
Model a rectangular mounting plate.
- Plate 120 mm along X, 80 mm along Y, 8 mm thick along Z.
- Bottom face on Z = 0; plate centred on the origin in X and Y.
- Four through holes, diameter 9 mm, each centre 12 mm from both adjacent edges.
- One central through bore, diameter 30 mm.
- All four vertical outer edges rounded with radius 6 mm.
Required PARAMS keys: length, width, thickness, corner_hole_d, edge_offset, bore_d, corner_radius.
probes: length 120 → 160: holes stay 12 mm from the edges

tasks.title: Pipe flange
tasks.prompt:
Model a circular pipe flange.
- Flange disc: outer diameter 160 mm, thickness 18 mm, from Z = 0 to Z = 18, centred on the Z axis.
- Raised face on top: diameter 100 mm, height 3 mm (Z = 18 to Z = 21).
- Central through bore, diameter 64 mm.
- 8 through bolt holes, diameter 18 mm, equally spaced on a 125 mm pitch circle diameter; the first hole centre lies on the +X axis.
Required PARAMS keys: outer_d, thickness, bore_d, raised_face_d, raised_face_h, bolt_count, bolt_hole_d, pcd.

tasks.title: Gusseted angle bracket
tasks.prompt:
Model a gusseted L-shaped angle bracket (all dimensions in mm).
- Base plate: X from 0 to 80, Y from 0 to 50, Z from 0 to 6.
- Upright plate: X from 0 to 6, Y from 0 to 50, Z from 0 to 60.
- Inside bend: fillet radius 5 on the concave edge where the base top meets the upright inner face (the edge along Y at X = 6, Z = 6).
- One triangular gusset, 6 thick, centred at Y = 25 (Y from 22 to 28); in the XZ plane it is the triangle (6,6), (46,6), (6,46).
- Two slots through the base, 9 wide and 29 long overall (rounded ends), long axis along X, centred at X = 55 and at Y = 12 and Y = 38.
- Two through holes in the upright, diameter 11, axis along X, at (Y = 12, Z = 40) and (Y = 38, Z = 40).
- Design intent: slots and holes are 12 mm from the Y edges; the gusset stays centred in Y.
Required PARAMS keys: length, width, height, thickness, bend_radius, gusset_thickness, gusset_leg, slot_width, slot_length, slot_center_x, hole_d, hole_z, edge_offset.
probes: width 50 → 70: slots/holes stay 12 mm from edges, gusset re-centres

tasks.title: Finned heat sink
tasks.prompt:
Model a finned heat sink (all dimensions in mm).
- Square base 60 x 60, 5 thick, centred on the origin in X and Y, from Z = 0 to Z = 5.
- 9 straight fins on top of the base, each 1.6 thick along X, running the full 60 length along Y, 25 tall (Z = 5 to Z = 30).
- Fins equally spaced at a 7 mm pitch along X, symmetric about X = 0 (fin centres at X = -28, -21, ..., 28).
- Four through holes in the base, diameter 3.4, at (±25, ±25).
Required PARAMS keys: base_size, base_thickness, fin_count, fin_thickness, fin_height, fin_pitch, hole_d, hole_offset.

tasks.title: Actuator gearbox housing
tasks.prompt:
Model an open-top actuator gearbox housing (all dimensions in mm).
- Main box: 100 along X, 70 along Y, 50 tall along Z, centred on the origin in X and Y, bottom on Z = 0, open at the top.
- Walls 4 thick, floor 5 thick. Outer vertical edges rounded R8 (inner cavity corners R4).
- Bearing boss on the +X wall: cylinder diameter 46, axis along X at (Y = 0, Z = 25), protruding 8 beyond the +X outer face (to X = 58).
- Bearing bore diameter 32, through the boss and the wall, same axis.
- Four internal screw columns, diameter 10, full height from the floor to Z = 50, centred at (±40, ±25), merged with the walls.
- Each column has a blind tapped hole, diameter 4.2, 12 deep from the top face.
Required PARAMS keys: length, width, height, wall, floor, corner_radius, boss_d, boss_len, bore_d, boss_z, column_d, column_inset, tap_d, tap_depth.

tasks.title: Liquid cold plate
tasks.prompt:
Model a liquid-cooling cold plate with an internal serpentine channel (all dimensions in mm).
- Block 120 along X, 80 along Y, 12 thick along Z, centred on the origin in X and Y, bottom on Z = 0.
- Internal channel, rectangular section 8 wide x 4 high, between Z = 4 and Z = 8 (4 mm of material above and below).
- The channel makes 5 straight passes along X, centred at Y = -28, -14, 0, 14, 28; channel centre lines run from X = -45 to X = 45.
- Consecutive passes are joined by U-turns (square corners are acceptable), alternating ends: the first turn at X = +45 (between Y = -28 and -14), the next at X = -45, and so on.
- Inlet port: vertical hole, diameter 8, from the top face down into the channel at (X = -45, Y = -28). Outlet port: same at (X = 45, Y = 28).
- The channel must not break out of the block anywhere else.
- Four through mounting holes, diameter 6.6, at (±54, ±34).
Required PARAMS keys: length, width, thickness, channel_width, channel_height, channel_z, passes, pass_pitch, straight_half, port_d, mount_hole_d, mount_dx, mount_dy.
probes: passes 5 → 3 (outlet moves with the last pass)

tasks.title: Shaft support assembly
tasks.prompt:
Model a shaft support assembly of four positioned parts (all dimensions in mm, one common coordinate system).
build() must return a dict with exactly these keys: "base_plate", "housing_left", "housing_right", "shaft" — each value a cadquery Workplane holding one solid, already in its assembled position.
- base_plate: 160 along X, 60 along Y, 10 thick, centred on the origin in X and Y, Z from 0 to 10.
- housing_left / housing_right: blocks 20 along X, 56 along Y, 45 tall, sitting on the plate top (Z 10 to 55), centred at X = -50 and X = +50, Y = 0.
- Each housing has a horizontal bore along X at (Y = 0, Z = 40) with 0.2 mm radial clearance around the shaft (bore diameter 20.4).
- shaft: diameter 20, length 140, axis along X at (Y = 0, Z = 40), centred on X = 0.
- Bolted interface: vertical Ø9 holes through each housing and through the plate, coaxial, at (X = ±50, Y = ±20).
- Parts must touch where they are seated but must not interfere.
Required PARAMS keys: plate_length, plate_width, plate_thickness, housing_x, housing_width, housing_depth, housing_height, axis_z, shaft_d, shaft_length, clearance, bolt_d, bolt_dy.
probes: shaft_d 20 → 25: bores follow with the same clearance
housing_x 50 → 60: plate bolt holes follow the housings

tasks.title: Engineering change — flange bore
tasks.prompt:
Engineering change request ECR-0412 on the existing pipe flange model below.
Change: increase the central bore diameter from 64 mm to 76 mm.
Preserve: the bolt pattern (8 x Ø18 on a 125 mm PCD, first hole on +X), the raised face (Ø100 x 3), the outer diameter (160) and the overall thickness (18 + 3). Keep the model parametric with the same PARAMS keys.
Return the complete modified code.

tasks.title: Engineering change — bearing bore
tasks.prompt:
Engineering change request ECR-0587 on the existing actuator housing model below.
Reason: the supplier bearing changes from 32 mm to 35 mm outside diameter.
Change: increase the bearing bore from Ø32 to Ø35, and increase the boss diameter from 46 to 49 so that the boss wall around the bore stays 7 mm.
Preserve: the housing envelope (100 x 70 x 50), the boss axis and protrusion, the four screw columns and their Ø4.2 x 12 tapped holes, wall and floor thickness. Keep the model parametric with the same PARAMS keys.
Return the complete modified code.

tasks.title: BenchCAD edit — bearing retainer cap
tasks.prompt:
Engineering change on the existing model below.
Change: Make the mounting flange thicker to 8.45.
Preserve every other feature. Return the complete modified program. For this task the PARAMS/build() contract is optional; the program must end with `result = <the cadquery Workplane>`.

Preserve every other feature. Return the complete modified program. For this task the PARAMS/build() contract is optional; the program must end with `result = <the cadquery Workplane>`.
